Matter contains "information" about itself. So, in a black hole, neither the matter nor the information about it is destroyed. When an atomic particles are collapsed into a singularity, some of that information is changed, the way the matter of the particles are changed.

The same way the matter conversion gives off energy, so does the information conversion. This information-induced energy is called Hawking Radiation. Unlike all matter and light, it's the only thing that comes OUT of a black hole, and it "is" the equivalent of the "information" put into the black hole.

Kind of like the way the chemical conversion of octane (gasoline) to carbon dioxide and water produces energy radiated from your car as heat, sound, and motion, a black hole converts everything/anything into Hawking Radiation.
